It was held in Germany between 15 June and 29 June 2005, as a prelude to the 2006 FIFA World Cup.  The tournament was won by 2002 FIFA World Cup winners Brazil, who defeated Argentina 4–1 in the final at the Waldstadion in Frankfurt.
